comparison_contract.rule: Pair only when every listed field agrees and requested_time_us may differ. Record both complete frame identities and event IDs. Reject any other mismatch. This comparison key does not change revision lineage, crop authority, cache keys, or mutation checks.
comparison_contract.geometry_metric: polygon IoU >= 0.5; preserve coverage denominators; cards and piles are separate; unpaired references are uncovered, not misses; unpaired predictions are outside that quality scope.

zero_card_outcome_contract.successful_detector_zero_cards: A successful result with zero individual-card candidates requires no pose. Preserve pile regions separately and state that no cards were detected; do not assert reviewed absence.
zero_card_outcome_contract.mixed_recording: Keep calibration and fitting requirements for frames with individual-card candidates.
zero_card_outcome_contract.no_candidate_recording: Do not invent calibration or invoke pose fitting only to create an empty result.
zero_card_outcome_contract.downstream: Identity performs no crop or model work on zero-card frames. Observation assembly retains frame/event coverage and pile evidence under existing contracts. Missing/failed upstream evidence is not an empty success or gameplay assertion.
zero_card_outcome_contract.blocking_failures: Actual calibration, crop-authority, pose, source, or lineage failures stop dependent work.
